mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market slack that triggers central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as policy easing commences.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 in late-cycle expansions signals manufacturing slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as growth concerns rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.0% indicates monetary tightening that increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth above 140,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth below 0.2% combined with unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates over the medium term, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
